51501993.DESCRIPTION: Binding affinity to human GLS1 assessed as dissociation constant by surface plasmon resonance analysis
51501993.original_paragraph: The SPR binding assays were performed on a Biacore T200 instrument (GE Healthcare). GLS1 protein (1 mM, 200 mL) was covalently coupled on CM5 chip according to standard procedure. The  whole system was equilibrated overnight first with assay buffer (10 mM Tris pH 8.5, 150 mM NaCl, 0.05% (v/v) surfactant P20, and 0.25% (v/v) dimethyl sulfoxide). Compounds were diluted with an assay buffer and then injected at a flow of 30 mL/min for 60 s to contact, followed by disassociation for 400 s. The equilibrium dissociation constants of the compounds were determined by Biacore T200 evaluation software (GE Healthcare).

assay_conditions.running_buffer_composition: 10 mM Tris pH 8.5, 150 mM NaCl, 0.05% (v/v) surfactant P20, and 0.25% (v/v) dimethyl sulfoxide
